scope: ADMET/BBB rule-based prediction only; structure-based docking NOT performed (AutoDock Vina unavailable in sandbox).
bbb_rule: likely_CNS+ iff TPSA<=90 AND 1<=cLogP<=4 AND HBD<=3 AND 150<=MW<=500 (heuristic, not validated QSAR).
note_strongest_candidate: phenazone (antipyrine): LINCS reversal hit (CS=-1.45) AND predicted CNS+ (rule-based) AND, independently, a clinically established CNS-penetrant analgesic -> credible brain-penetrant repurposing candidate to dampen microglial activation in OIH. The CNS+ call rests on BOTH the (heuristic) predictor AND the independent literature fact, not on the predictor alone.
calibration_caveat: The rule-based BBB predictor FALSIFIED on the positive-control caffeine (known CNS+, but flagged CNS- because cLogP=-1.03 < 1). The heuristic therefore over-penalizes polar CNS agents and is EXPLORATORY/qualitative only; CNS+ calls are suggestive, not definitive. Docking-free ADMET cannot replace measured logBB.
